summary.headline: Cohance Q2 FY27 revenue rose 13% QoQ to INR4,767m and adjusted EBITDA margin improved to about 10%, but management guides H2 YoY growth on revenue and EBITDA.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue was about INR4,767m, up roughly 13% sequentially from about INR4.2bn in Q1, with adjusted EBITDA of INR458m (about 10% margin) versus INR92m in Q1. Adjusted PAT turned positive, but results remained below last year on lower Pharma CDMO and AgChem contribution and adverse mix. Management reiterated that H2 FY27 should grow year-on-year on both revenue and EBITDA, though the Suryapet facility closure order adds uncertainty that has not yet been quantified. Specialty Chemicals guidance was cut to a year-on-year decline for FY27.

segments.name: Pharma CDMO
segments.commentary: Led Q2 sequential recovery, with revenue up 34.5% QoQ on small molecules; revenue down 27% YoY in Q2 and 32% in H1. ADCs saw customer destocking across two commercial programs in H1.

segments.name: API+ (API and Formulations)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR2,671m (+5% YoY) on audit disruption and delayed shipments. Raw material price increases hit select APIs; partial pass-through underway, and YTD material margin % is still ahead of last year.

segments.name: Specialty Chemicals
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR417m, down 40.6% YoY on lower agrochemical CDMO volumes, pricing pressure and program phasing. FY27 revenue now expected to decline YoY (previously broadly flat).

segments.name: NJ Bio (ADC bioconjugation)
segments.commentary: Restructuring and reorganization underway with a goal of breakeven. Two ADC GMP campaigns delivered in Q2; bioconjugation capacity expansion on track for commercial availability by early FY2028.

segments.name: Sapala (nucleic acids)
segments.commentary: Growth of 33.6% YoY in Q2 and 83% in H1, achieved without early phase III supplies; integration with the Cohance network is starting.

guidance_outlook: H2 FY27 expected to deliver YoY growth in both revenue and EBITDA; management said H2 should be stronger than H1.
Management expects half-on-half improvement but declined to give specific EBITDA guidance; said Q2 EBITDA margin of about 9% can be the base to improve from.
Specialty Chemicals FY27 revenue now expected to decline YoY, versus earlier expectation of broadly flat.
Two newly won patent-protected small molecule commercial programs: first campaign revenue expected in Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28 (RSM supply).
NJ Bio targeted to reach breakeven; bioconjugation capacity commercial availability by early FY2028.
Specialty Chemicals new AI commercial launch expected from H2 CY2028.
capex_capacity: Group capex of a little over INR1bn in H1 FY27; additional capital programme planned over next few years for ADC payload linkers and bioconjugation.
Bioconjugation capacity expansion at NJ Bio on track for commercial availability by early FY2028.
Specialty Chemicals: targeted automation and environmental upgrades at multipurpose agrochemical facility plus dedicated R&D lab to speed customer qualification.
Suryapet facility (non-GMP, one of the smaller plants) subject to closure order; management is assessing impact and engaging authorities.
Pashamylaram, Shamshabad, Jaggayyapeta USFDA inspections completed; responses submitted; the FDA classification is pending (expected in 1 to 3 months per management).
demand_pricing: Multiple reload orders received on existing small molecule commercial programs, improving visibility into Q3, Q4 and FY28.
Three new large global pharma programs won in Q2 (two commercial, one phase III); phase III net count 11, commercial products moved to 19.
ADC demand softer in H1 due to destocking; RFQ activity broadening across payloads and linkers.
Generic API pricing described as stable: no major price increases or decreases; selective price revisions with customers.
Lifecycle management products: innovator pricing said to be slightly premium to generics; monetisation 18 to 36 months after sampling. Three European innovators engaged (two new, one existing).

qa_highlights.question: Nature of the two new commercial projects, lead time to revenue, and whether they are incremental to H2 guidance.
qa_highlights.answer: Both are patent-protected small molecules from large innovators. They are RSM (registered starting material) supply, first deliveries expected Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28. Management confirmed they are incremental to H2 guidance.

qa_highlights.question: Lifecycle management timelines, ASP trends and off-patent impact.
qa_highlights.answer: Gates run from engagement, qualification and audits to sampling, validation, multi-market filing and approval. Monetisation typically 18 to 36 months after sampling. Price erosion is limited; innovator pricing is slightly premium to generics.

qa_highlights.question: Suryapet revenue exposure and whether H2 guidance holds if the site stays shut.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is too early to quantify; the closure was a development in the last 24 hours. It will guide later on timing and H2 impact.

qa_highlights.question: Recovery of destocked revenue (INR260 crore) and restocking of the second molecule.
qa_highlights.answer: One molecule is becoming generic in 1 to 2 years and volumes are falling. Another patent-protected molecule has received good reloads for end FY27 and FY28. No revenue figure was given.

qa_highlights.question: Recurring vs one-off NJ Bio subsidiary cost savings (INR41 crore in Q1 to almost nil in Q2).
qa_highlights.answer: Costs were limited in Q2 due to restructuring transactions completed in the last 30 to 60 days. No further restructuring cost is expected in H2.

qa_highlights.question: Whether H2 EBITDA and margins will improve further.
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects HoH improvement in sales and EBITDA but gave no specific EBITDA guidance; Q2 EBITDA of about 9% is the base to improve from.

risks_watch: Suryapet closure order: revenue exposure undisclosed; reopening timing and impact on H2 guidance pending authority engagement.
USFDA classification of the three inspected facilities is pending; outcome could affect H2 shipments.
Inventory rose to about INR7.3bn from INR5.6bn, so cash conversion needs monitoring.
ADC customer destocking and generic erosion on two small molecule KSMs in the coming 1 to 2 years.
Raw material cost pressure on select API products; price pass-through is only partial.
Specialty Chemicals decline in FY27 with newer programs not yet offsetting legacy agrochemical pressure.
summary.management_tone: Cautious on near-term operations, confident on H2 direction. Management was openly reticent on Suryapet impact, FDA classification and EBITDA quantum, while being firm that H2 will grow YoY and that the pipeline is strengthening. Specialty Chemicals guidance was cut.
key_quotes: Based on the visibility we have today, we continue to expect H2of FY 2027 to deliver year-on-year growth on both revenue and EBITDA.
Q2 has progressed in line with that trajectory.
Given the performance of legacy Agrochemical products and the continuing generic pressure, we now expect Specialty Chemical revenue to decline year-on-year in FY27.
We do not anticipate any further cost in the second half of the year on account of these transactions, which were done in the last 30-60 days.

growth.why: H2 FY27 YoY growth in revenue and EBITDA is reiterated, backed by reload orders and two newly won patent-protected programs (first revenue Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28), but Specialty Chemicals FY27 is cut to a YoY decline, the Suryapet closure impact is unquantified, and no specific EBITDA guidance was given.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management expects half-on-half EBITDA improvement from a Q2 margin of about 9-10% (adjusted EBITDA INR458m vs INR92m in Q1), but gave no specific margin guidance, and raw material pressure is only partly passed through.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: NJ Bio bioconjugation capacity expansion on track for commercial availability by early FY2028, with a group capex of a little over INR1bn in H1 FY27 and an additional multi-year programme planned for ADC payload linkers and bioconjugation.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management expects H2 FY27 revenue to grow YoY, backed by reload orders and two new patent-protected programs (first RSM revenue Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28), though Specialty Chemicals FY27 is cut to a YoY decline and Suryapet exposure is unquantified.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: An additional capital programme for ADC payload linkers and bioconjugation is planned over the next few years, but no size or board approval was disclosed, and utilisation was not quantified.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Specialty Chemicals FY27 revenue was cut to a YoY decline, Suryapet revenue impact is unquantified, and the FDA classification is pending, so the guide is more likely to be held than raised.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: The Suryapet closure order is unquantified and the USFDA classification for three sites is pending in 1-3 months, which could push H2 shipments and the H2 YoY growth call out of reach.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Two newly won patent-protected small molecule commercial programs (RSM supply) have first deliveries expected in Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28, and Specialty Chemicals' new AI commercial launch is expected from H2 CY2028.

rows.label: NJ Bio ADC bioconjugation commercial availability
rows.why: Bioconjugation capacity expansion is on track for commercial availability by early FY2028, and NJ Bio is restructuring with a goal of breakeven after two ADC GMP campaigns in Q2.

rows.label: Reload orders and three new large pharma programs
rows.why: Multiple reload orders on existing small molecule programs and three new large global pharma programs won in Q2 (two commercial, one phase III) improve visibility into Q3, Q4 and FY28; phase III count is 11 and commercial products 19.

rows.label: USFDA classification for three inspected facilities
rows.why: Pashamylaram, Shamshabad and Jaggayyapeta inspections are complete with responses submitted, and the classification is pending, so the outcome could move H2 shipments either way.

tone.note: Management was confident that H2 FY27 grows YoY on revenue and EBITDA and that new programs are incremental, but cautious on Suryapet impact, the FDA classification, and EBITDA quantum; analysts pushed on Suryapet exposure, destocked revenue (INR260 crore) recovery and H2 margins.
